resources.string: Return to the saved board, position, items and time.
Please wait for the current operation to finish.
Could not save progress. The previous save is unchanged.
Progress saved. You can close the game.
Unsaved changes in the current level will be replaced.
Direction + ACTION: collect beside Murphy. Hold ACTION to place a red disk.\nGamepad: D-pad / left stick · X: action · A: confirm · START: pause.
Supaplex direction, action and confirm controls. Menu at top left, pause at top right.
Language changes the Android buttons and dialogs. The original DOS game menus stay in English.
Choose a movement style. All styles use only four directions. ACTION still works with a second finger.
Tap an arrow for a brief move; hold it to keep moving. Gaps and the centre are neutral. An animation already started can finish after release.
The base stays in place. Drag from the centre. Return to the centre or lift to stop. Direction stability reduces accidental turns near diagonals.
During a live level, touch the lower movement side to place the base under your thumb, then drag. The base stays there until you lift. In menus, start inside the visible circle.
Start inside the movement circle, swipe one way and keep your finger down to move. The direction stays locked even if your thumb drifts. Lift to stop or choose another direction.
Larger: ignore more small thumb movements near the centre. Affects joysticks and the initial swipe, not the four buttons.
Larger: more deliberate turns between horizontal and vertical. Centre and lift still stop input immediately. Applies to the two joystick styles.
Restore four buttons, default size and opacity, right-handed layout, and default dead zone/stability? Saves, language and picture proportions stay unchanged.

Up/down on the left, left/right on the right (mirrored in left-handed mode). The most recently pressed direction wins; releasing it returns to the other held direction. ACTION is available on both sides.
